overlapping_phenotypes: mild-to-moderate intellectual developmental delay and short stature / ARID
discriminating_phenotype: Preserved communicative speech and absence of progressive microcephaly or coarse facies
discriminating_logic: Unlike TRAPPC9 where severe expressive aphasia/nonverbal status, progressive post-natal microcephaly, obesity, and coarse facial features are common, SGSM3 patients attain communicative speech around age 5 and lack coarse facies/progressive microcephaly.
Short stature is consistently linked with biallelic SGSM3 loss-of-function, whereas CC2D1A patients typically maintain normal linear growth.
Short stature is consistently present in SGSM3 deficiency, whereas TUSC3 patients typically maintain normal linear growth.
